row.scim_plan: Pay as you go (no Edition required)
row.evidence: Twilio's SCIM API (https://iam.twilio.com/scim/v2) is authenticated with Organization OAuth apps, which 'are available to all accounts at no additional cost'; the SCIM guides list only an Organization Owner/Admin role and a verified domain as prerequisites, while SSO alone is limited to Twilio Editions.
row.notes: Status changed from gated to free. June said SCIM needed Enterprise plus the paid SSO Edition, but no current Twilio page says that: the SCIM overview, API reference and Okta/Entra guides name no Edition, SCIM does not need SSO, and OAuth apps are free for all accounts (US1 region only). SAML SSO is the part limited to Twilio Editions (Contact sales). Pricing is usage-based, so per-user fields are null. SCIM covers Users only (no Groups, no pagination); DELETE deactivates. Roles go through the OAuth-only Role Assignment API. SSO has no JIT. Confidence is medium because the docs show the absence of a gate rather than stating there is none.

plans.name: Pay as you go (usage-based)
plans.price_text: Free trial, then usage-based pricing per product
plans.notes: SCIM availability on base accounts inferred from the docs listing no Edition prerequisite and OAuth apps being free for all accounts.

plans.name: Twilio Editions (Administration, Security, Enterprise)
plans.notes: Editions extend audit-event retention from 30 to 400 days.

scim.plan: Pay as you go (no Edition required per docs)

auth.token_source: Admin Center > Applications > OAuth apps (Organization OAuth app with managed-users scopes; authorization code or client credentials)
auth.token_expiry: Access token 1 minute to 30 days, default 1 hour; refreshed via refresh token or client credentials

deprovision.data_retained: DELETE deactivates the user instead of deleting it; the Organization Owner cannot be deactivated via SCIM.

roles.how: Not through SCIM; roles are assigned with the separate Role Assignment API or in the Console/Admin Center.

limitations.text: Users' email domains must be verified; userName must equal the primary email.
No pagination (startIndex/itemsPerPage unsupported); filter only eq on userName/externalId.
Suspended users and the Organization Owner can't be updated or deactivated via SCIM.
OAuth apps (SCIM auth) supported only in the US1 region; with SSO enforced, a non-SSO Organization Admin is needed to authorize the Okta connection.
Entra provisioning uses a custom non-gallery app.

audit_log_api.plan: Pay as you go (30-day retention; 400 days with Editions)

limitations.text: Organization user management is only through SCIM endpoints and the OAuth-only Role Assignment API; account Auth Tokens and API keys are not accepted.

okta.notes: OIN markup checks SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate. Twilio's own Okta SCIM guide instead builds a custom SWA app with SCIM.

entra.notes: Twilio documents Entra SCIM with a custom non-gallery app; no Learn gallery tutorial for Twilio (only Twilio SendGrid).

fallbacks.other_sync: Bulk User Import of existing Twilio users on verified domains
